QuestionStmt.S: By dropping a stone in a quiet lake, a wave in the form of circle is generated. The radius of the circular wave increases at the rate of $2.1 \text{ cm/sec}$. Then the rate of increase of the enclosed circular region, when the radius of the circular wave is $10 \text{ cm}$, is (Given $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$)

Solution.S:
Area of circle $A = \pi r^2$. Differentiate with respect to time:
$$\frac{dA}{dt} = 2\pi r \frac{dr}{dt}$$
Given $\frac{dr}{dt} = 2.1$ cm/s, $r = 10$ cm, $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$:
$$\frac{dA}{dt} = 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 10 \times 2.1 = \frac{44}{7} \times 21 = 44 \times 3 = 132 \text{ cm}^2/\text{s}$$
Thus the correct option is C.
